title: Interspecies clock comparison below $5 \times 10^{-18}$ uncertainty with a transportable clock
summary: We report a measurement of the optical frequency ratio between the $^2\mathrm{S}_{1/2}(F=0)$--${^2\mathrm{F}_{7/2}(F=3)}$ electric-octupole (E3) transition of $^{171}$Yb$^{+}$ and the $^1\mathrm{S}_0$--${^3\mathrm{P}_0}$ transition of $^{87}$Sr, $ν_{\mathrm{Yb}^{+}}/ν_\mathrm{Sr} = 1.495\,991\,618\,544\,900\,588\,1(65)$.
